translations.web: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
translations.bsb: When Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting, he said to Moses, “The sound of war is in the camp.”
translations.kjv: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
